name: Combloux
description: Combloux is famous for its extraordinary 360° panorama of Mont Blanc — arguably the best viewpoint in the entire region. The village has the first biotope swimming lake in France (ecologically treated, naturally heated). Saint-Nicolas church with double-bulb bell tower is one of the most beautiful baroque churches in Haute-Savoie. The Portes du Mont-Blanc ski area (100km, 1,200-1,930m) links Combloux, Megève-Jaillet, and La Giettaz. Evasion Mont-Blanc pass (445km) also available. A charming, authentic village ideal for families.

overview.atmosphere: Family-friendly village with the most spectacular Mont Blanc panorama in the Alps. Biotope swimming lake. One of the most beautiful baroque churches in Haute-Savoie. Linked to Megève and La Giettaz via Portes du Mont-Blanc ski area (100km).

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Paragliding, snowshoeing, horse-drawn carriage, snowmobiling, handiski pioneer, guided off-piste

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude (1,100m) — snow can be variable
